title: Malicious code in @clikwraps/navigate (npm)
description: The npm package @clikwraps/navigate version 99.9.1 contains malicious code through its dependency on an unpinned tarball URL hosted on Google Cloud Storage. Installing this package results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine due to lifecycle scripts in the fetched tarball. The package itself is a stub, and the malicious behavior arises entirely from the dependency resolution mechanism. This is consistent with a dependency confusion or resolution hijack attack.
